006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.stream.Stream;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IStringItem;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItem;
021import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
022import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
023import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
024
025/**
026 * Provides new Metapath functions that evaluate a Metapath recursively over
027 * sequences generated by evaluating that expression.
028 */
029public final class MpRecurseDepth {
030  private static final String NAME = "recurse-depth";
031
032  @NonNull
033  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_ONE_ARG = IFunction.builder()
034      .name(NAME)
035      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_EXTENDED)
036      .deterministic()
037      .contextDependent()
038      .focusDependent()
039      .argument(IArgument.builder()
040          .name("recursePath")
041          .type(IStringItem.type())
042          .one()
043          .build())
044      .returnType(INodeItem.type())
045      .returnZeroOrMore()
046      .functionHandler(MpRecurseDepth::executeOneArg)
047      .build();
048
049  @NonNull
050  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_TWO_ARG = IFunction.builder()
051      .name(NAME)
052      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_EXTENDED)
053      .deterministic()
054      .contextDependent()
055      .focusIndependent()
056      .argument(IArgument.builder()
057          .name("context")
058          .type(INodeItem.type())
059          .zeroOrMore()
060          .build())
061      .argument(IArgument.builder()
062          .name("recursePath")
063          .type(IStringItem.type())
064          .one()
065          .build())
066      .returnType(INodeItem.type())
067      .returnZeroOrMore()
068      .functionHandler(MpRecurseDepth::executeTwoArg)
069      .build();
070
071  private MpRecurseDepth() {
072    // disable construction
073  }
074
075  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
076  @NonNull
077  private static ISequence<INodeItem> executeOneArg(
078      @NonNull IFunction function,
079      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
080      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
081      IItem focus) {
082
083    if (!(focus instanceof INodeItem)) {
084      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
085          focus,
086          focus == null
087              ? String.format("Expected non-null type '%s', but the node was null.", INodeItem.class.getName())
088              : String.format("Expected type '%s', but the node was type '%s'.",
089                  INodeItem.class.getName(),
090                  focus.getClass().getName()));
091    }
092    ISequence<INodeItem> initalContext = ISequence.of((INodeItem) focus);
093
094    ISequence<? extends IStringItem> arg = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
095    IStringItem recursionPath = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arg.getFirstItem(true));
096
097    return recurseDepth(initalContext, recursionPath, dynamicContext);
098  }
099
100  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
101  @NonNull
102  private static ISequence<INodeItem> executeTwoArg(
103      @NonNull IFunction function,
104      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
105      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
106      IItem focus) {
107
108    ISequence<INodeItem> initalContext = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
109
110    ISequence<? extends IStringItem> arg = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(1)));
111    IStringItem recursionPath = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arg.getFirstItem(true));
112
113    return recurseDepth(initalContext, recursionPath, dynamicContext);
114  }
115
116  @NonNull
117  private static ISequence<INodeItem> recurseDepth(
118      @NonNull ISequence<INodeItem> initialContext,
119      @NonNull IStringItem recursionPath,
120      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
121    IMetapathExpression recursionMetapath
122        = IMetapathExpression.compile(recursionPath.asString(), dynamicContext.getStaticContext());
123    return recurseDepth(initialContext, recursionMetapath, dynamicContext);
124  }
125
126  /**
127   * Evaluates the {@code recursionMetapath} starting with the the items in the
128   * {@code initialContext} and also recursively using the resulting items
129   * returned by evaluating this path.
130   *
131   * @param initialContext
132   *          the sequence containing the initial node items to evaluate the
133   *          Metapath against
134   * @param recursionMetapath
135   *          the Metapath expression to use for recursive evaluation
136   * @param dynamicContext
137   *          the dynamic context supporting evaluation
138   * @return the Metapath node items resulting from the Metapath execution
139   */
140  @NonNull
141  public static ISequence<INodeItem> recurseDepth(
142      @NonNull ISequence<INodeItem> initialContext,
143      @NonNull IMetapathExpression recursionMetapath,
144      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
145
146    return ISequence.of(ObjectUtils.notNull(initialContext.stream()
147        .flatMap(item -> {
148          @NonNull
149          ISequence<INodeItem> metapathResult = recursionMetapath.evaluate(item, dynamicContext);
150          ISequence<INodeItem> result = recurseDepth(
151              // ensure the sequence is list backed
152              metapathResult.reusable(),
153              recursionMetapath,
154              dynamicContext);
155          return ObjectUtils.notNull(Stream.concat(Stream.of(item), result.stream()));
156        })));
157  }
158}
